context_notes: Phase 22 UAT surfaced 10 fixes across Phase 22, Phase 21, and Phase 20. Two architectural pieces of Phase 21 work were never finished: (a) Phase 21-03 left an empty placeholder in Openh264Decoder.cpp:676 where the production sink-delivery code was supposed to land — the comment 'Plan 21-03 will replace this comment with...' shipped verbatim, causing every decoded frame to be silently dropped before reaching the tile; (b) Phase 21-03 was also supposed to widen m_remoteuser_mirror to carry username for multi-broadcaster matching but didn't, leaving the kHoldCapDrop=4 hammer to drop video snapshots when N≥2 peers have audio activity. JamWide's Phase 22 UAT was the first time the production receive path got end-to-end live testing (Phase 21 UAT used the JAMWIDE_BUILD_TESTS path which registered its own RawData_Callback, so this bug stayed hidden). External cross-AI review (Javier @ NinjamZap) caught two additional encoder-side issues (inline SPS/PPS in IDR breaking VT receivers, allow_skip_frames=1 causing silent frame drops that VT can't recover from).
